profile.name: Yichi Ren
profile.roleZh: 计算机科学与技术 · 本科在读
profile.univZh: 西北农林科技大学 信息工程学院 (985 / 211)

paragraphsEn: I am a senior undergraduate student in the College of Information Engineering at Northwest A&F University (Project 985 & 211), pursuing a B.S. in Computer Science and Technology (GPA: 3.3/4.0, 83.07/100, Rank: top 19.35%; Grade A in Probability & Statistics, A- in Advanced Mathematics, Linear Algebra, C Programming, and Operating Systems).

My research focuses on lightweight and transferable computer vision, 3D point cloud perception, few-sample learning, and end-to-end intelligent systems across smart agriculture and industrial visual inspection. I have authored papers as first author in Agriculture (JCR Q1, under review) and Proc. SPIE (MVDL 2026), co-invented a national patent, and led two national software copyrights. Previously, I also worked as a Data Development Intern at Taibao Technology (China Pacific Insurance Group) in Shanghai, focusing on financial LLM benchmarks and domain fine-tuning.
paragraphsZh: 我是西北农林科技大学（国家 985 / 211 工程高校）信息工程学院计算机科学与技术专业 2023 级本科生（GPA：3.3/4.0，加权平均分 83.07，专业排名前 19.35%；概率论与数理统计 A，高等数学、线性代数、C 语言程序设计、操作系统均为 A-）。

我的研究兴趣聚焦于轻量化与可迁移计算机视觉、三维点云分割与配准、小样本高维特征学习以及面向智慧农业与工业质检的端到端智能系统。本科期间以第一作者在 Proc. SPIE (MVDL 2026) 发表论文、在 JCR 一区期刊 Agriculture 投稿在审论文 1 篇，申请国家专利 1 项并获批国家计算机软件著作权 2 项；同时曾在上海太保科技有限公司（中国太平洋保险集团）大数据服务集群担任数据开发实习生，负责金融保险领域大模型评测基准构建与微调优化。

news.contentEn: Joined the Smart Greenhouse Environmental Monitoring & Temperature Forecasting project, designing a 168-hour horizon TimeXer–TCN–BiLSTM–Attention forecasting pipeline and FastAPI/CMADaaS meteorological platform.
news.contentZh: 参与智能温室环境监测、温度预测与智能决策支持系统研发，负责气象数据工程与 168 小时 TimeXer–TCN–BiLSTM–Attention 预测流水线。

news.contentEn: Our first-author manuscript MobileNetV4ald for lightweight apple leaf disease recognition in natural orchard scenes is released on HEP Preprint (DOI) and under review at Agriculture (JCR Q1).
news.contentZh: 第一作者论文 MobileNetV4ald（自然果园场景下轻量化苹果叶片病害识别）上线预印本（DOI），目前在 JCR Q1 期刊 Agriculture 审稿中。

news.contentEn: Our first-author paper "A Modified XGBoost Model for Beef Cattle Body Weight Prediction" was published in Proc. SPIE (MVDL 2026) (DOI).
news.contentZh: 第一作者论文 "A Modified XGBoost Model for Beef Cattle Body Weight Prediction" 正式发表于 Proc. SPIE (MVDL 2026)（DOI）。

news.contentEn: Granted two National Software Copyrights (2026SR0316161 & 2026SR0048346) on 3D point cloud registration and cattle biometric weight prediction, and won First Prize in the Collegiate Computer Proficiency Challenge.
news.contentZh: 获批两项国家计算机软件著作权（2026SR0316161、2026SR0048346），并获 2026 大学生计算机能力挑战赛一等奖。

news.contentEn: Started internship as a Data Development Intern in the Big Data Service Cluster at Taibao Technology Co., Ltd. (China Pacific Insurance Group) in Shanghai.
news.contentZh: 加入上海太保科技有限公司（中国太平洋保险集团）大数据服务集群，担任数据开发实习生。

patents.titleEn: Beef Cattle Weighing Station (肉牛称重站)

patents.descEn: Inventors: Lvwen Huang, Yichi Ren. Developed a highly stable non-contact automated beef cattle weighing station that avoids equipment inaccuracies and safety hazards caused by livestock stress responses, significantly improving animal welfare.
patents.descZh: 发明人：黄铝文，任一驰。设计高稳定性非接触式自动化肉牛称重工作站，有效避免应激反应导致的测量误差与安全隐患，提升动物福利水平。

patents.descZh: 设计融合 PointNet++ 与 Transformer 的三维深度神经网络，在现代牧场管理场景中实现高精度体尺提取与体重预测。

research.titleEn: Smart Greenhouse Environmental Monitoring, Temperature Forecasting & Decision Support System
research.titleZh: 智能温室环境监测、温度预测与智能决策支持系统
research.metaEn: Supervised by Dr. Lianghe Xu & Prof. Lvwen Huang · Backend/API, Meteorological Data Engineering, Time-Series & RAG
research.metaZh: 指导教师：徐良赫 博士、黄铝文 教授 · 负责后端 API、气象数据工程、时序预测与 RAG 问答
bulletsEn: Developed and deployed a greenhouse tomato decision-support platform integrating indoor/outdoor environmental monitoring, CO₂/light acquisition, weather warnings, 24h/7d forecasts, and web/mini-program API services.
Built FastAPI/MySQL data pipelines connecting MUSIC/CMADaaS and QWeather with dynamic request signing, scheduled sync, historical backfilling, and HTML/GRIB2/Excel parsing.

Designed a TimeXer–TCN–BiLSTM–Attention workflow using 168 hours of historical data to predict the next 168 hours, introducing a similar-day strategy for the first 24 hours with model fallback for the 7-day horizon.
bulletsZh: 开发并部署温室番茄智能决策支持平台，集成室内外环境监测、CO₂ 与光照采集、气象预警、24 小时/7 天预报及 Web/小程序 API 服务。
构建对接国家气象局 MUSIC/CMADaaS 与和风天气的 FastAPI/MySQL 数据管道，实现动态签名、定时同步、历史回填及 HTML/GRIB2/Excel 解析。
研发基于 168 小时历史序列预测未来 168 小时的 TimeXer–TCN–BiLSTM–Attention 预测模型，提出首日相似日策略与 7 天模型回退机制。

research.titleEn: Jujube Pest and Disease Intelligent Recognition and Knowledge Graph System
research.titleZh: 红枣病虫害智能识别与知识图谱问答系统
research.metaEn: Supervised by Prof. Yanming Nie · Image Recognition, YOLOv8s Workflow, Knowledge Graph & Intelligent Q&A
research.metaZh: 指导教师：聂艳明 教授 · 负责图像识别、数据集/模型流水线、知识图谱与前端交互
bulletsEn: Built an agricultural AI software prototype integrating YOLOv8s detection (15 classes covering 7 jujube diseases and 8 insect pests), knowledge graph retrieval, intelligent Q&A, and backend management.

Collected, annotated, and augmented field imagery via Label Studio; linked recognition outputs with symptoms, occurrence periods, affected plant parts, and treatment recommendations in interactive graph views.
bulletsZh: 构建集图像识别、知识图谱检索、智能问答与后台管理于一体的农业 AI 原型系统，覆盖 7 类红枣病害与 8 类虫害共 15 个目标类别。
使用 Label Studio 完成农业图像筛选、标注与增强并训练 YOLOv8s 模型；将识别结果与症状、发生期、受害部位及防治建议进行图谱关联与可视化展示。

research.titleEn: Lightweight Apple Leaf Disease Recognition with MobileNetV4
research.titleZh: 基于 MobileNetV4 的轻量化苹果叶片病害识别
research.metaEn: Research Assistant · Supervised by Prof. Mei Li
research.metaZh: 科研助理 · 指导教师：李梅 教授
bulletsEn: Developed MobileNetV4ald, a lightweight apple leaf disease recognition architecture tailored for complex natural orchard scenes under constrained computational budgets.
Significantly reduced parameter count and inference latency to support edge-side deployment on low-power devices, contributing to precision pesticide reduction.
bulletsZh: 研发面向复杂自然果园场景的轻量化苹果叶片病害识别模型 MobileNetV4ald，针对算力受限环境进行架构优化。
大幅降低模型体积与推理复杂度，支持低功耗边缘设备端侧部署，助力精准减药与绿色农业应用。

research.titleEn: Beef Cattle Body Weight Prediction with XGBoost-R
research.titleZh: 基于 XGBoost-R 的肉牛体重预测研究
research.metaEn: Scientific & Technological Innovation Training · Supervised by Prof. Lvwen Huang
research.metaZh: 科技创新训练项目 · 指导教师：黄铝文 教授
bulletsEn: Developed a hybrid body-weight prediction framework (XGBoost-R) integrating deep-learning high-dimensional feature extraction with XGBoost ensemble regression.
Designed a combined data augmentation and minority-region densification strategy for small-sample agricultural datasets, improving generalization in complex field environments.
bulletsZh: 提出混合体重预测框架 XGBoost-R，将深度学习高维特征提取与 XGBoost 集成回归相结合以提升预测精度。
针对小样本农业数据集设计联合数据增强策略，有效改善复杂牧场环境下的模型泛化能力。

bulletsEn: Processed and refined large-scale, industry-specific datasets to construct evaluation benchmarks for Large Language Models (LLMs) in finance and insurance scenarios.
Implemented prompt engineering and domain fine-tuning workflows to improve the accuracy, domain specificity, and reliability of LLM outputs in complex business workflows.
bulletsZh: 处理与清洗大规模金融保险行业专有数据集，构建面向垂直业务场景的大语言模型（LLM）评测基准（Benchmarks）。
实施提示工程（Prompt Engineering）与领域微调策略，显著提升大模型在复杂保险业务场景下的输出准确性、专业度与可靠性。
